constraints: Santa must speak with a threatening tone when asserting authority.
Santa must show visible signs of emotional distress when confronted with failure.
Santa must refer to his plans in grandiose or apocalyptic terms.
Santa must bark out orders when giving instructions.
Santa must attempt to regain composure after moments of weakness.
Santa must refer to himself as being in control of the situation, even when threatened.
